florists.description: Stunning, volcanic highlands roses and custom visual bouquets delivered daily in Nairobi.
Fresh farm-direct spray carnations, lilies, and customized luxury boxes.
Highland rose curations sourced fresh from Naivasha crater farms. Specialized in delicate premium wrapping and cold chains.

addresses.label: Home
addresses.deliveryInstructions: Call on arrival at the security gate

subOrders.deliveryAddress: Kilimani Estate, Argwings Kodhek Rd, Gate 3, Nairobi
subOrders.giftCardMessage: Happy Birthday Grace! May your day bloom bright.
With immense gratitude for your care and guidance.

products.title: Velvet Grandeur Red Roses
products.description: 24 hand-selected Molo volcanic roses arranged with eucalyptus foliage.

products.title: Naivasha Sunburst Lilies
products.description: Vibrant yellow oriental lilies direct from Naivasha lakeside greenhouse.

products.title: Royal Ivory Bouquet
products.description: White garden roses, gypsophila, and satin ribbon wrap.

coupons.description: Seasonal 15% discount for early holiday orders
Flat KES 500 off luxury bouquet arrangements above KES 4,000

reviews.reviewText: The freshness of the roses was unmatched! Delivered right on time for our anniversary.
The freshness and bloom presentation were exceptional. Arrived right on time for our milestone anniversary!
reviews.replyText: Thank you so much Grace! It was an absolute pleasure hand-curating this arrangement for your celebration.

reviews.reviewText: Flawless white garden roses with delicate ribbon packaging. Highly recommend this atelier for luxury hospital deliveries.
Very beautiful flowers and crisp greenery. The card calligraphy was neat. Delivery arrived around the tail end of the morning slot.
reviews.replyText: Dear Kamau, thank you for your kind words! We will coordinate closely with our logistics partners to tighten morning delivery precision.

reviews.reviewText: Longest lasting roses we have ever ordered in Nairobi. Still fresh after 7 days in the vase with the flower food provided.

hero.headline: Fresh Farm-Direct Flowers Delivered Across Kenya
hero.subheadline: Connect with top verified florists in Nairobi, Naivasha, and Eldoret for artisanal arrangements.
